value: Pipeline approvals and export growth underpin re-rating

Aster Pharma Ltd. is an integrated pharmaceutical company manufacturing formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for domestic and export markets, with a growing presence in the US generics segment.
Consolidated revenue grew 20.2% YoY in Q1FY26 to Rs. 2,140cr, led by strong US generics and domestic branded formulations growth.
EBITDA margin expanded 160bps YoY to 21.9% on a richer product mix and operating leverage.
Received 3 new ANDA approvals from the USFDA during the quarter, taking cumulative approvals to 47.
Reported PAT rose 35.0% YoY to Rs. 289cr.
Aster Pharma's expanding US pipeline and steady domestic growth support continued earnings momentum. We maintain ACCUMULATE with a revised target price of Rs. 1,420, based on 18x FY27E P/E.
